title: Mexico City bank money in Bernard Barker's pocket traced to casino skim
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Mexico City bank money in Bernard Barker's pocket traced to casino skim, about 1960s-1972 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: assassination wow because that bank account where those monies came out of where those bills were in Bernard Barker's pocket was in the bank account of this lawyer by the name of agario

plain: Dan Sheehan, who talks about hidden US politics on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells a story about cash found in the pocket of a man named Bernard Barker. Sheehan says the bills came out of a Mexico City bank account belonging to a lawyer he names as Agario, and he links that money to cash skimmed off casinos, bringing in the name Carlos Marcello as well. If true, it ties Barker's money to organized crime and, as Sheehan hints, to an assassination.
